brief: Goldman recommends buying the Power Up America basket (GSENEPOW), calling it the most underappreciated AI bottleneck: positioning across all five sub-categories (grid infrastructure, uranium/nuclear, natural gas, IPPs, equipment) sits near a two-year low and valuations have de-rated, while GS research argues fundamentals are intact or improving rather than deteriorating. The theme's YTD underperformance versus other AI trades and the S&P 500 is attributed to political and regulatory noise (utility-bill affordability ahead of the November midterms, state-level permitting pushback, NIMBY opposition), not fundamentals. Demand forecasts were raised, not cut: GS sees 108 GW of data center power demand by 2030 (23% CAGR) and a 3.5% total US power demand CAGR. Equipment demand remains strong (GEV guiding to 125 GW of backlog plus slot reservations by year end, roughly 6x current capacity) and construction activity accelerated in July-August even as announcement momentum cooled. Key dated catalysts: FERC's October 12 ruling on PJM's large-load framework, PJM RBP filings, 3Q earnings, the November midterms, and the ERCOT interconnection audit finalizing December 10. One implementation idea: sell the 31-Dec 85% put to fund a 110%/135% call spread on GSENEPOW for 1.75% into year-end.
